description: Per-project size budget for the shared BuildingBlocks projects under src/BuildingBlocks/. Each entry caps the number of .cs files and lines of code (excluding blank lines and single-line // comments). The BP-005 architecture test (BuildingBlocksGrowthBudgetTests) measures each project at test time and fails if the actual size exceeds its budget. Initial values are the measured size at 2026-04-13 plus the larger of +10% or +5 files / +100 LOC of headroom. Raising a budget requires a reviewed commit explaining why the new code is genuinely shared-kernel work and could not live inside an owning module — see docs/QUALITY_GATES.md.
